question: Rajya Sabha enjoys which special power under Article 312 of the Constitution of India?

options.text: To appoint members of Human Rights Commission
To create new All India service
To extend special rights to certain people

solution:
The correct answer is __**To create new All India service**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 312 of the Constitution of India grants the Rajya Sabha the special power to create new All India Services.
 
• This power is exercised by passing a resolution with a majority of not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting.
 
• All India Services are unique to India and include services such as the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS).
 
• The establishment of new All India Services is aimed at ensuring a uniform standard of administration across the states of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 312 of the Constitution of India:**

 
 
• It empowers Parliament to create new All India Services if the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution to that effect by a two-thirds majority.
 
• All India Services are crucial for maintaining high standards of governance and uniformity in administration throughout the country.
 
 
 
• **All India Services:**
 
 
• These services are common to both the Union and the States.
 
• Officers of these services serve both under the Central Government and State Governments, ensuring a bridge between the Centre and the States.
 
• IAS, IPS, and IFS are the existing All India Services.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha's Role:**
 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India and represents the states and union territories.
 
• It has the power to pass resolutions that can lead to the creation of new All India Services.
 
• This ensures that the states have a say in the creation and functioning of such important services.
